plain_summary_en: This paper studies How Shared Interactional Histories Shape Local Practices: Mutual Adaptation of Participants’ Stance and Affect Displays in Assessment Activities. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is How, Shared, Interactional, Histories. The abstract suggests a mixed methods approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
